findings.title: SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym raises NoMethodError when default_locale is nil
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` evaluates `SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym` on every call, and `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` (called from `ApplicationController#set_locale` on every request) also reaches this expression. If `SiteSetting.default_locale` is nil (e.g. before the site settings row exists, during a fresh install/seed, or in a misconfigured environment), `to_sym` raises NoMethodError and crashes the request. The trailing `.compact` does not guard this case, because the exception is raised before `compact` runs. Use a safe form such as `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale&.to_sym, :en].compact.uniq` and ensure there is at least one non-nil element.

findings.title: FallbackLocaleList inherits from Hash but does not implement the I18n::Locale::Fallbacks contract
findings.body: The class replaces the standard `I18n::Locale::Fallbacks` (which itself extends Hash) but only overrides `[]` and adds `ensure_loaded!`. The real class also defines `[]=`, `defaults`, and `defaults=`. With this replacement, any caller that does `I18n.fallbacks[locale] = [...]` or reads/writes `I18n.fallbacks.defaults` will silently use Hash defaults — our `[]` always recomputes from `SiteSetting.default_locale`, so any explicitly configured fallbacks are ignored without warning. Iterating `I18n.fallbacks.each` will likewise yield nothing because the underlying hash is empty. Either implement the missing methods (store explicit overrides and consult them before computing) or stop inheriting from Hash so the misleading API surface is removed and behaviour is explicit.

findings.title: `compact` silently swallows a nil I18n.locale instead of surfacing the bug
findings.body: `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` relies on `compact` to drop a nil `locale`. A nil `I18n.locale` is an upstream problem (e.g. `current_user.effective_locale` returning nil in `ApplicationController#set_locale`) and translations will still resolve via `[default_locale, :en]`, hiding the misconfiguration. Either remove `compact` so the nil propagates as a real error, or replace it with an explicit guard that logs/warns when `locale` is nil and falls back intentionally.

findings.title: No specs cover the new server-side localization fallback behaviour
findings.body: The diff adds a non-trivial behaviour change (custom `FallbackLocaleList` with a `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en]` chain, eager loading via `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` from a `before_filter`, and a new `I18n.ensure_loaded!` patch in `translate_accelerator.rb`) but ships without any test files. At minimum there should be specs covering: the fallback order when user_locale, default_locale and `:en` are distinct; that a missing key in the user locale falls back to the default locale and then English; that `set_locale` preloads all three locales so the first `I18n.t` call after a switch does not return a missing translation; and the `uniq`/`compact` behaviour when `default_locale == :en` or `user_locale == default_locale`. Without these, regressions in fallback ordering or loading will not be caught.

findings.title: Fallback array is rebuilt on every request and every translation lookup
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` allocates a fresh `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` array on every call. After this PR, it is invoked once per request by `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` and again on every `I18n.t` lookup through the `Fallbacks` backend. The standard `I18n::Locale::Fallbacks` memoises the result per locale. Caching the array (e.g. with a `@cache = {}` keyed by `locale.to_sym`) avoids the per-call allocation and the repeated `SiteSetting.default_locale`/`to_sym` work in the hot path.
